conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: AI ethics refers to the set of moral principles and values that guide the design, development, and use of artificial intelligence to ensure it benefits humanity. It addresses concerns about fairness, accountability, and transparency in AI systems.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
